results.title: 🇨🇳‼️ Kremlin has increased the gas discount for China to 56%.
results.description:
🇨🇳‼️ Kremlin has increased the gas discount for China to 56%.

The discount on Russian gas purchased by China via the Power of Siberia pipeline, launched seven years ago, will reach an unprecedented level this year, according to budget law materials published in the State Duma database.

Gazprom's average annual price for the Chinese market will be $247.9 per thousand cubic meters. Meanwhile, the company's other customers abroad will pay $562. This brings the discount to $315 per thousand cubic meters, or 56%.

Compared to last year, the discount for China will increase by 15%: then, China purchased gas for $240.3 per thousand cubic meters, compared to $406.5 from Gazprom's other customers abroad (a 41% discount).

Next year, according to budget documents, the Kremlin will continue to sell gas to Beijing at practically half price: $251.3 per thousand cubic meters, 46% lower than other foreign supplies ($450).

For 2028, the Ministry of Economic Development is projecting a reduction in discounts to 32% ($247.8 versus $361.9), and for 2029, to 24% ($246.4 versus $323.2).

results.title: China has bought about €290bn of Russian fossil fuels since the EU bans.
results.description:
China has bought about €290bn of Russian fossil fuels since the EU bans.

India about €170bn. Türkiye about €110bn.

The EU itself still bought about €80bn, mostly gas plus pipeline crude.

China and India took 87% of Russia’s crude.

September still brought Moscow €625m a day.

Washington has just waived its new sanctions on buyers too.

The barrels changed customers. 

Moscow still gets paid.

results.title: Russia has nearly shipped 20 million barrels of oil to Asia through the Northern Sea Route in 2025.
results.description:
Russia has nearly shipped 20 million barrels of oil to Asia through the Northern Sea Route in 2025. Disruptions to traditional shipping routes have prompted traders to favor the Arctic route. Indian imports of Russian crude have fallen significantly as Chinese refiners increased their purchases. Gazprom Neft is planning to increase Arctic shipments by 35% this year compared to 2025. (Credit: Times of India)
#Cargo #Shipping #SupplyChain

results.title: Yes, of course, China is incredibly interested in ending the war.
results.description: Yes, of course, China is incredibly interested in ending the war. So interested, in fact, that Chinese companies are taking advantage of discounted Russian energy resources due to sanctions and Russia's loss of much of the European market. You have to be incredibly naive to ignore China's economic interests. There is a big difference between those who claim to want peace and those who benefit economically from the current situation.
